# langsmith_org_role (Data Source)

Looks up a LangSmith organization or workspace role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_org_role" "organization_user" {
  name = "ORGANIZATION_USER"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Role display name.
- `name` (String) Role machine name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID for the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission names assigned to the role.
